reviews.comment: Coming in as a freshman, her teaching methods are definitely interesting. Her lectures are a bit long and when she critiques, it's really good advice but then tells you that she doesn't like it after she's already said it. She basically says one thing and then does another, and does this especially at the last project you'll do for her.

just don't take her as your prof ever. ESPECIALLY IN SUMMER! literally just don't she will tell you to do a project a certain way and advise you throughout only to "forget" her advising and destroy ur work come finals. Be prepared for uncomfortable & discouraging commentary. I am at a loss of words on how she was even a firstyear professor for 105.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Roger's class was interesting. It's VERY project heavy! There were 3 projects in total and 10 quizzes that accounted for our grade. She is probably the best when it comes to being more hands-on as an architecture student. Her feedback is ok, she changed her mind a bunch and will tell you different things. Repeatedly ask her for advice.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great class. She is very sweet and helps whenever you really need it. A little tough but overall a great experience!

1 Quiz a week based off lecture at beginning of week, 14 or so quizzes all count for 10%, two major projects both worth 40-50% of final grade. Dr. Rogers is not demanding, but expects you to work! She values craftsmanship (hand-drawings, technical drawing skills, hand-cutting materials) over computer skills. She's very open as long as you initiate.

There are 3 projects and quizzes which are pretty easy as long as you take notes during lecture and read the chapters assigned. She is very nice and is willing to help and give feedback. Overall a very good class, you know what is expected for each project and she is very clear when explaining the projects.

This prof is boring. She enjoys the image of being helpful but will discipline you on the grade if you fall out of line (as other comment suggests). She reminds me of all the high school teachers I endured to just "get through" or "get by." Would not recommend.

Dr. Rogers is a good professor, but she doesn't give a lot of feedback unless you ask. She is pretty unpredictable when it comes to grading for projects so be prepared. I would definitely choose her for a first time freshman studio. She is a nice lady and is willing to help you if you put forth effort.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Her lectures are very practical and give a good intro into architecture and design skills that you'll continually utilize. So the quizzes aren't difficult if you've listened in class and read the textbook. When it comes to projects, her standards are very high and subjective. Very effective teacher who will help you channel your abilities.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: 2 Major projects, and 10 quizzes (study night before). Mrs. Rogers made my first semester of studio extremely enjoyable! Yes, this is a hard class because its studio and requires a lot of creativity, but if you work hard and show her that you really want to make your project the best that it can be, she will give you a fair grade. She's great.

Her class is VERY hard, but I gained so much every day I spent in the studio.  She knows what she wants and makes it very clear what is needed for every project.  If you listen to her, you will succeed.  She knows her stuff and has experience.  She would often come to the studio outside of class time to continue helping and giving desk crits.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I had Rogers for my second semester studio and it was a very trying semester. I ended up getting a C in the class but it was the wake up call I needed. Overall I learned a ton from her and if I had the chance to do it over again I would. She is real with her students and gives her honest opinion on everything and is very helpful in that respect.

Give her a chance. There are alot of people who have a poor experience with her because she teaches first year students and she is hard. Since it is first year they haven't been criticized before in their artistic work like they will be in college. This usually isn't fun. She can be very helpful if you listen and have any common sense about you.

Dr Rogers was one of the most unhelpful professors I have ever had. She used to hold a position in the department but is now back to teaching and boy is she rusty. She shows favoritism for students that like her. Her guidelines change, and she can screw you over in a project with her lack of clarity. Horrible teacher. Horrible guidance. Horrible.
